prose: Retinal scanners at the Vault 00 entrance fail to authenticate the Chief Architect's surviving lineage due to age-related macular changes and cataracts. Because the automated security protocol forbids password overrides, the sealed inner sanctum doors remain magnetically deadlocked against the very people who designed them.

The multi-stage electrostatic and borosilicate particulate banks have accumulated 420kg of radioactive sub-micron dust from the upper intake chimneys. Backwashing with ultrasound has restored only 60% flow capacity. The automated diagnostic warns that in eighteen months, air intake must be throttled to 30 liters per person per hour.

Synthetic lipid tanks #4 through #8 have undergone thermal decomposition. The stored triglyceride emulsion has turned yellow and viscous, smelling of burnt tallow and copper wire. Calorie synthesis yield has dropped 30%, forcing the automated cafeteria dispensaries to dilute daily porridge with ground diatomaceous earth.

Annual automated fire-suppression drill executed without warning in Sector 5. 800 kilograms of Halon 1301 flooded the server corridors in eighteen seconds, reducing atmospheric oxygen to 2.4%. Three maintenance drones recorded zero optical fire signatures; the drill logged 100% compliance over the empty concrete halls.

Seismic settling along the granite basement fault has shifted the three-meter-thick interlocking lead-bismuth radiation curtain. A fourteen-millimeter vertical gap has opened near the main electrical trunk line, allowing gamma shine from the contaminated bedrock aquifer to bathe the upper service catwalks in 240 uSv/hr.

Due to temperature fluctuations in the unheated crystal oscillator bay, the mainframe's real-time clock has accumulated a drift of 5,800,000,000 clock cycles. The bunker's legal AI believes the current calendar year is 2210 and has automatically declared all pre-war civil rights charters, property deeds, and food rationing statutes permanently expired.

Final biological census complete. Dwellers present: 0. The robotic incinerator in Medical Suite 1 completed the cremation of Subject 01 (Architect Marcus Vance, age 84) at 09:12. All corridor lights have been dimmed to 5% security luminance to conserve diesel fuel. The HVAC blowers continue to whisper to empty rooms.
